tax.text: She supports raising the marginal tax rate on earners above $500,000 and closing a tax loophole.
tax.quote: I support the elimination of the "Buy, Borrow, Die" tax loop-hole, the increase of the marginal tax rate of earners of over $500,000.00 per year

wages.text: She supports fair pay and says workers' right to unionize for better pay and working conditions should be protected.
wages.quote: Free speech and the right to unionize for better pay and working conditions must not be interfered with

schools.text: She supports educational resources wherever families choose to educate their children while prioritizing public education services.
schools.quote: We prioritize educational resources wherever families choose to educate their children, but prioritize providing public education services that are developmentally appropriate

cannabis.text: She says marijuana use should not be criminalized, supports regulated commercial products, and would allow adults to grow it for personal use.
cannabis.quote: Marijuana use should not be criminalized. Any commercial marijuana product should be highly regulated. Adults should be permitted to grow marijuana for their own use.

health.text: She supports investing in Medicare, Medicaid, and Tricare so all Americans can benefit from publicly funded health care.
health.quote: We must invest in Medicare, Medicaid and Tricare to allow all Americans to benefit in real time from the healthcare taxpayers invest in.

wages.text: Wilson said there should be no government-imposed minimum wage and that labor should be priced by the market.
wages.quote: There should be no government-imposed minimum wage. Labor, like every other commodity should be priced by the market.

schools.text: As a delegate, he said he proposed multiple amendments supporting school choice, including charter schools and a homeschooling tax credit.
schools.quote: I think I offered 15 different amendments over the course of three hours in support of school choice, or I like to call it an education liberty.

immigration.text: As a delegate, he sponsored a bill penalizing officers who fail to enforce an immigration-detainer agreement.
immigration.quote: Creating a criminal penalty for an agent or sworn officer who refuses or fails to enforce the Compact Agreement on Detainers in immigration cases

guns.text: He described himself as a staunch supporter of Second Amendment rights.
guns.quote: I am a staunch supporter of Second Amendment rights, I have an A plus from the WVCDL.

abortion.text: As a delegate, he co-sponsored the Life at Conception Act, which declared a right to life for born and preborn human persons.
abortion.quote: To implement equal protection for the right to life of each born and preborn human person

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: As a delegate, he sponsored a bill requiring students to compete with students of the same biological gender.
gender.quote: Requiring students to compete only against students of the same biological gender

health.text: Wilson selected the position that taxpayer-funded health care should be abolished, including Medicaid and Medicare.
health.quote: Taxpayer funded health care should be abolished in all forms, and Medicaid and Medicare should be defunded.

energy.text: His campaign says he would promote West Virginia’s energy economy, cut regulations, and pursue lower costs and more jobs.
energy.quote: West Virginia families are being crushed by inflation, runaway energy costs, and a federal government that punishes producers and rewards dependence. Marshall will fight to unleash West Virginia's energy economy, cut regulations that strangle small businesses, and put hard-working Mountain State families first.

voting.text: Wilson strongly disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification.
